items.title: Howie Shear interviewed by Monk Rowe, Dunkirk, New York, October 11, 2014
items.q: I heard myself on a Barry Manilow album once

ctx.x: So in those days if you were watching television or in your car on the radio and you heard a Burger King commercial you might say oh, that’s me.

Yeah. I’ve walked in malls to go shopping and I’m in the store and I heard myself on a Barry Manilow album once, and things like that. And I’m saying it sounds familiar — oh I just did that. You know it’s kind of surreal.
